summary: Large commercial car park among shops; homes only across surrounding roads.
reasons: Car park backed by retail buildings
Homes 23 m or more, across roads

best_section.where: Southern edge of the car park, along the wall and hedge above the street

drivers.seclusion: Backed by a retail building and a wall; nearest dwellings are 23-26 m away across the road to the south.
drivers.access_and_room: Open car park entered from Woodville Street with plenty of marked bays; no gate seen across it.
drivers.traffic: Shopping precinct beside two roads; busy by day, probably quiet overnight.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked; no sign of overnight stays, and it may be customer parking.

flags: Likely customer or business parking; check on site
Loading-zone and school-time no-stopping signs on Woodville Street
Noise from the roads and shops
sun_shade: Open sky; a large tree shades the middle and the hedge shades the south edge in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is private or time-limited
